verses.arabicText: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.transliteration: Innā arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi an andhir qawmaka min qabli ay-yatiyahum ʿadhābun alīm
verses.translation: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people ˹saying to him˺, “Warn your people before a painful punishment comes to them.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.transliteration: Qāla yāqawmi innī lakum nadhīrum-mubīn
verses.translation: Noah proclaimed, “O my people! I am truly sent to you with a clear warning

verses.arabicText: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.transliteration: Ani uʿ'budū l-laha wa-ittaqūhu wa-aṭīʿūn
verses.translation: worship Allah ˹alone˺, fear Him, and obey me

verses.arabicText: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Yaghfir lakum min dhunūbikum wayu-akhir'kum ilā ajalim-musamman inna ajala l-lahi idhā jāa lā yu-akharu law kuntum taʿlamūn
verses.translation: He will forgive your sins, and delay your end until the appointed time. Indeed, when the time set by Allah comes, it cannot be delayed, if only you knew!”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا
verses.transliteration: Qāla rabbi innī daʿawtu qawmī laylaw-wanahārā
verses.translation: He cried, “My Lord! I have surely called my people day and night

verses.arabicText: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًا
verses.transliteration: Falam yazid'hum duʿāī illā firārā
verses.translation: but my calls only made them run farther away

verses.arabicText: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَـٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-innī kullamā daʿawtuhum litaghfira lahum jaʿalū aṣābiʿahum fī ādhānihim wa-is'taghshaw thiyābahum wa-aṣarrū wa-is'takbarū is'tik'bārā
verses.translation: And whenever I invite them to be forgiven by You, they press their fingers into their ears, cover themselves with their clothes, persist ˹in denial˺, and act very arrogantly

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا
verses.transliteration: Thumma innī daʿawtuhum jihārā
verses.translation: Then I certainly called them openly

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا
verses.transliteration: Thumma innī aʿlantu lahum wa-asrartu lahum is'rārā
verses.translation: then I surely preached to them publicly and privately

verses.arabicText: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
verses.transliteration: Faqul'tu is'taghfirū rabbakum innahu kāna ghaffārā
verses.translation: saying, ‘Seek your Lord’s forgiveness, ˹for˺ He is truly Most Forgiving

verses.arabicText: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا
verses.transliteration: Yur'sili s-samāa ʿalaykum mid'rārā
verses.translation: He will shower you with abundant rain

verses.arabicText: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَـٰرًا
verses.transliteration: Wayum'did'kum bi-amwāliw-wabanīna wayajʿal lakum jannātiw-wayajʿal lakum anhārā
verses.translation: supply you with wealth and children, and give you gardens as well as rivers

verses.arabicText: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
verses.transliteration: Mā lakum lā tarjūna lillahi waqārā
verses.translation: What is the matter with you that you are not in awe of the Majesty of Allah

verses.arabicText: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
verses.transliteration: Waqad khalaqakum aṭwārā
verses.translation: when He truly created you in stages ˹of development˺

verses.arabicText: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا
verses.transliteration: Alam taraw kayfa khalaqa l-lahu sabʿa samāwātin ṭibāqā
verses.translation: Do you not see how Allah created seven heavens, one above the other

verses.arabicText: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
verses.transliteration: Wajaʿala l-qamara fīhinna nūraw-wajaʿala sh-shamsa sirājā
verses.translation: placing the moon within them as a ˹reflected˺ light, and the sun as a ˹radiant˺ lamp

verses.arabicText: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا
verses.transliteration: Wal-lahu anbatakum mina l-arḍi nabātā
verses.translation: Allah ˹alone˺ caused you to grow from the earth like a plant

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا
verses.transliteration: Thumma yuʿīdukum fīhā wayukh'rijukum ikh'rājā
verses.translation: Then He will return you to it, and then simply bring you forth ˹again˺

verses.arabicText: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا
verses.transliteration: Wal-lahu jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa bisāṭā
verses.translation: And Allah ˹alone˺ spread out the earth for you

verses.arabicText: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا
verses.transliteration: Litaslukū min'hā subulan fijājā
verses.translation: to walk along its spacious pathways.’”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
verses.transliteration: Qāla nūḥur-rabbi innahum ʿaṣawnī wa-ittabaʿū mal-lam yazid'hu māluhu wawaladuhu illā khasārā
verses.translation: ˹Eventually,˺ Noah cried, “My Lord! They have certainly persisted in disobeying me, and followed ˹instead˺ those ˹elite˺ whose ˹abundant˺ wealth and children only increase them in loss

verses.arabicText: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا
verses.transliteration: Wamakarū makran kubbārā
verses.translation: and who have devised a tremendous plot

verses.arabicText: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا
verses.transliteration: Waqālū lā tadharunna ālihatakum walā tadharunna waddaw-walā suwāʿaw-walā yaghūtha wayaʿūqa wanasrā
verses.translation: urging ˹their followers˺, ‘Do not abandon your idols—especially Wadd, Suwâ’, Yaghûth, Ya’ûq, and Nasr.’

verses.arabicText: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَـٰلًا
verses.transliteration: Waqad aḍallū kathīraw-walā tazidi ẓ-ẓālimīna illā ḍalālā
verses.translation: Those ˹elite˺ have already led many astray. So ˹O Lord˺, only allow the wrongdoers to stray farther away.”

verses.arabicText: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًا
verses.transliteration: Mimmā khaṭīātihim ugh'riqū fa-ud'khilū nāran falam yajidū lahum min dūni l-lahi anṣārā
verses.translation: So because of their sins, they were drowned, then admitted into the Fire. And they found none to help them against Allah

verses.arabicText: وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
verses.transliteration: Waqāla nūḥur-rabbi lā tadhar ʿalā l-arḍi mina l-kāfirīna dayyārā
verses.translation: Noah had prayed, “My Lord! Do not leave a single disbeliever on earth

verses.arabicText: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا
verses.transliteration: Innaka in tadharhum yuḍillū ʿibādaka walā yalidū illā fājiran kaffārā
verses.translation: For if You spare ˹any of˺ them, they will certainly mislead Your servants, and give birth only to ˹wicked˺ sinners, staunch disbelievers

verses.arabicText: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا
verses.transliteration: Rabbi igh'fir lī waliwālidayya waliman dakhala baytiya mu'minaw-walil'mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti walā tazidi ẓ-ẓālimīna illā tabārā
verses.translation: My Lord! Forgive me, my parents, and whoever enters my house in faith, and ˹all˺ believing men and women. And increase the wrongdoers only in destruction.”
